<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 127.0997, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.092 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 8 %) suggests about 7–8 carbons. The formula C₈H₁₄O has a calculated exact mass of 126.1045 Da, matching the observed mass within experimental tolerance and giving an expected M+1 intensity (~8.8 %) consistent with the data. Therefore the molecular formula is C₈H₁₄O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
